intro: This leg of the investigation finally confirms the sinister truth connecting the elusive tutor to Darkshire's records. Clerk Daltry successfully matches the handwriting found on the recovered documents to Stalvan Mistmantle, prompting an immediate report to Commander Althea Ebonlocke. It marks the moment the Night Watch's suspicions harden into undeniable fact.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Let Commander Ebonlocke know immediately that the handwriting matched, friend! Her suspicions were correct!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I knew it! Fine work, friend.
